description: The same money paid in each year for a child until 18, into a Junior ISA and into a Junior SIPP with its basic-rate tax relief, grown at the same rate: the pot at 18 and at the minimum pension age, and when the child can get each. Use for 'Junior ISA or Junior SIPP for my daughter', 'what would £2,880 a year in a Junior SIPP grow to'.

childAge.description: The child's age now, in whole years, 0 to 17.

growthPct.description: Growth a year, the same on both, e.g. 5. Defaults to 5.

yearly.description: Paid in each year until 18, in pounds, up to £9,000 (the most a Junior ISA takes). A Junior SIPP takes up to £2,880, which tax relief makes £3,600.

name: calculate_junior_isa_vs_sipp
title: Junior ISA vs Junior SIPP
